fields.options: Each morning before sunrise AstroHQ asks the astrology service where the planets are, works out for each of the 12 signs where they stand counted from that sign, and asks the writer below to put it in plain words in English and Hindi. The writer is given only those numbers. The readings are kept as drafts until you publish them (or tick the box below). They appear on the Consult page above the free reports.

fields.label: Publish at once
fields.description: Off: each reading waits as a Draft until staff publish it. On: it is shown as soon as it is written.

fields.label: Where the words are written
fields.description: Old hub: the address and key below. AISpark Services: through IntegrationHQ's AISpark Services account (the server's services, with this site's customer key). Change it here to go back at any time.

fields.label: AISpark Services account
fields.description: Leave empty to use the one that is connected.

fields.label: Hub address
fields.description: For example http://127.0.0.1:8800. No trailing slash.

fields.label: Hub site name
fields.description: Only when the hub serves several sites on one address; sent as X-Frappe-Site-Name.

fields.label: Seconds to wait for one reading
Write today's readings now
fields.description: Writes the signs that have no reading yet for today. Safe to press again.
